title: Curse Sommelier
pitch: Drink a cursed vintage and the debuff hits instantly — but win enough battles while it ages in your blood and it matures into a permanent blessing.
howto: Uncork bottles in your cellar, swallow their curses, then descend into arena battles: every won battle ages every curse you carry, and a fully aged curse inverts into its paired blessing forever. Grind gold and bottles from the dark to buy vintages, sommelier upgrades and extra blood slots, and blend two curses at once for rare compound blessings.
controls: Tap an enemy to charge and strike it. Tap or drag the floor to move. Everything else is buttons.
